blurb: Guests embark on private fishing charters from Dana Point Harbor targeting a variety of fish species including yellowtail, halibut, white sea bass, bluefin tuna, and more. Trips range from short coastal excursions to full day offshore and island trips. The operator provides all fishing gear, bait, and expert guidance tailored to all skill levels.
